library.name: TontooUI
library.description: SwiftUI-inspired declarative UI layer for TontooOS

content_unavailable_view.name: Content Unavailable
content_unavailable_view.message: Check the spelling or try a new search.

picker.name: Picker
picker.custom_value_label_desc: Creates a picker that generates its label from a localized string key and accepts a selection binding.
picker.multiple_sources_desc: Creates a picker that updates the selected property for all sources.
picker.picker_with_assets_desc: Creates pickers with title, image, systemImage, and custom label.
picker.tabs_style_desc: A picker style that presents options as segmented tabs. On macOS, this style uses a tab view.
picker.wheel_style_desc: A picker style that presents the options in a scrollable wheel that shows the selected value in the center.
picker.segmented_style_desc: A picker style that presents the options in a segmented control. Use this style for a small number of options.
picker.palette_style_desc: A picker style that presents the options as a row of compact elements. When the palette is expanded, options are shown in a grid.
picker.radio_group_style_desc: A picker style that presents the options as a group of radio buttons.
picker.navigation_link_style_desc: A picker style represented by a navigation link that presents the options in a list when tapped.
picker.menu_style_desc: A picker style that presents the options as a menu when the user presses the picker.
picker.inline_style_desc: A PickerStyle where each option is displayed inline with other views in the container.
picker.wheel_item_height_desc: Sets the default wheel-style picker item height.
picker.horizontal_radio_desc: Sets the style for radio group style pickers within this view to be horizontal.

color.name: Color
color.color_variants_desc: HierarchicalShapeStyle, a shape style that maps to one of the numbered content styles
color.separator_colors_desc: The UIKit separator colors that are also used in other components, such as the separator in List
color.content_background_colors_desc: The UIKit colors that are also used in other components like in List and Form backgrounds
color.text_colors_desc: The UIKit text colors that are also used in other components, such as the placeholder in TextField
color.fill_colors_desc: The UIKit fill colors that indicate the fill of a view
color.label_colors_desc: The UIKit label colors for text
color.semantic_colors_desc: The semantic colors that adapt to the current color scheme

text.name: Text
text.text_format_desc: Creates a text view that displays the formatted representation of a non-string type
